# Copilot Instructions — duotyping.com

See `AGENTS.md` at the repo root for the canonical, shared instructions.

## Commit messages

Follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): `<type>[optional scope]: <description>`

Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`.

- Description: imperative mood, lowercase, no trailing period.
- Breaking change: append `!` after type/scope (e.g. `feat!:`) and/or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
- Body (optional): explain why, not what.
